# fiscozen-api

> fiscozen-api is an open source (MIT), **unofficial** PHP client and MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for Fiscozen, the Italian VAT/partita IVA accounting service. It lets developers and AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex) manage invoices, customers, expenses, F24 tax deadlines and documents of their own Fiscozen account. It is **not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by Fiscozen S.p.A.**

Progetto open source non ufficiale: client PHP e server MCP per Fiscozen (fatture elettroniche, clienti, scadenze F24, documenti) da codice, da Claude e da ChatGPT. Non affiliato a Fiscozen S.p.A.

Key facts:
- Language: PHP 8.1+, single dependency (Guzzle). License: MIT.
- Login uses the account's SMS two-factor authentication. The client never bypasses it and never registers a trusted device: a new SMS code is needed every time the session expires.
- Creating an invoice assigns its number but does NOT send it to SDI. Sending to SDI is a separate, irreversible call, disabled by default in the MCP server (FISCOZEN_MCP_ALLOW_SDI=1 + confirm:true).
- MCP transports: stdio (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor) and Streamable HTTP with bearer token (ChatGPT connectors, OpenAI Responses API, Claude API MCP connector).
- It uses Fiscozen's private web API, which may change without notice.

## Support
- Help and questions: gabriele@windroses.world
- Bugs: https://github.com/gabriele-wink/fiscozen-api/issues
- Problems with a Fiscozen account must go to Fiscozen, not to this project.
